style.summary: MyFitnessPal stacks white cards with 15 pt corners and 24 pt padding on light screens under a pale blue-grey header tint. Bright blue #0066EE fills every main button as a full pill, while teal, purple and orange code carbs, fat and protein. Store shots set the app on a warm stone photo under bold white headlines.

traits.text: 16 pt screen margins; 361 pt cards with 24 pt padding and 12 pt gaps; macros sit in 3 columns of 94 pt.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Cards round at 15 pt and fields at 6 pt with 2 pt borders; buttons are 48 pt pills, progress bars 8 pt.

traits.label: Color

traits.label: Components

trial.evidence: "Snag a free Premium pass. 7 days, risk-free!" on the web pricing page; the App Store description says "start your free Premium trial today"

ourRead: Monthly, $19.99, anchors Annual: 12 months cost $239.88, so $79.99 saves 67%. A year also costs "about the same as 1 hour with a nutrition expert".
All 5 buttons say START FREE TRIAL, and 4 open the Annual checkout, as does "Claim offer". Monthly gets one outlined button.
The App Store text names 2 tiers, Premium and Premium Plus, but all 10 listed items are Premium. The web sells $79.99 a year and $19.99 a month; the App Store adds $49.99 a year and $9.99 a month.

improvements.title: Put the 7 days on the button
improvements.detail: All 5 buttons say "START FREE TRIAL"; the 7 days sit in the top banner and in a closed FAQ answer. Print "Start 7 days free" on the Annual button and "Then $79.99 a year" under it.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Trade both badges for $6.67 a month
improvements.detail: The same Annual card says "Best value!" under the 8/10, then "Most popular!" in the plan picker. Swap both tags for its monthly cost, $6.67, next to Monthly's $19.99.
improvements.rule: Delete filler badges ("New", "AI-powered", "Beta") unless they change a decision.

improvements.title: Fill the plan sections with flat blue
improvements.detail: The plan sections fade from the icon blue, #0066EE, to lavender #8A81FA at the bottom left. Fill them with flat #0066EE, so yellow stays the one bright color.

stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in MyFitnessPal's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% white #FFFFFF: cards, sheets and screens below the header.
- 30% stone grey #746A61: hero and onboarding backdrops, as in the store shots.
- 10% bright blue #0066EE: main buttons, links, goal values and the calorie bar.
- Macros: carbs #2CB9B1, fat #6C0D8F, protein #FEB13D. Secondary text #6C6C70.
Type:
- Headlines: Inter 700, about 28 to 46 pt, tracking -3%.
- Body: Inter 400, 14 pt; values Inter 700, 20 pt, units 12 pt grey.
Shapes:
- Cards 15 pt corners; fields 6 pt with a 2 pt #BEC5CF border; buttons 48 pt pills; bars 8 pt pills.
Layout:
- 16 pt margins, 24 pt card padding, 12 pt gaps; a #CDD9E2 tint behind the header.
Components:
- Week row: 7 circles; done days fill black with a white check.
- Calorie card: label, 20 pt value, "/ goal" in grey, full-width 8 pt blue bar.
- Food row: name, green check, "kcal, portion" in grey, red trash icon at right.
Icons and imagery:
- Thin line icons; real food photos with 12 pt corners.
Check:
- Every main button is a #0066EE pill.
- Macro colors match on every screen.
- Cards sit 12 pt apart with 24 pt padding.
